lines.en: label utaspring2:
scene clearnightsky
I can do anything I want.
lines.zh: 我可以做任何我想做的事。

lines.en: And for the most part, I have.
lines.zh: 而大体上，我确实做到了。

lines.en: My life is a series of resets and repeats — one where I return to the same habits and hobbies I’ve blanketed myself in because I’m always in need of warmth. Always in need of {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 我的人生是一连串的重置与重复——我总是回到那些把自己裹在里面的习惯和爱好中，因为我永远需要温暖。永远需要{i}某样东西{/i}。

lines.en: And right now, that something is air.
lines.zh: 而眼下，那样东西是空气。

lines.en: I’ve expelled my worries from the depths of my lungs in an attempt to envelop myself in happier days, but I’ve been left a step or two away from suffocating and must now replenish what I’ve lost.
lines.zh: 我把忧虑从肺的深处排了出去，想把自己裹进更快乐的日子里，结果却离窒息只剩一两步，现在必须把失去的补回来。

lines.en: I’m not sure how a blanket is going to help me in this case, though.
lines.zh: 不过我不确定，在这种情况下一条毯子能帮上我什么忙。

lines.en: And while I’m trying a little harder than I have been to not immediately think of fashioning it into something I can hang myself with (for Ami’s sake), that’s the only thing that comes to mind.
lines.zh: 虽然我已经比之前更努力地在控制自己，不要立刻就想把它做成某个能上吊的东西（为了 Ami 着想）——可我脑子里冒出来的也只有这个。

lines.en: The problem is, that puts me in quite the predicament as I’m now going to die in this metaphor no matter what I do considering my options are “hang” or “stop breathing.” Both of which are essentially interchangeable.
lines.zh: 问题是，这样一来我就陷入了两难：不管我怎么选，在这个比喻里我都必死无疑，因为我的选项是“上吊”或者“停止呼吸”。而这两者基本上可以互换。

lines.en: So for the sake of my life and your entertainment, please allow me to start all over.
lines.zh: 所以为了我的小命，也为了各位的消遣，请允许我重新开始。

lines.en: I can do anything I want.
lines.zh: 我可以做任何我想做的事。

lines.en: And for the most part, I have.
lines.zh: 而大体上，我确实做到了。

lines.en: So maybe tonight, I’ll reset or repeat something meaningful.
lines.zh: 所以也许今晚，我要重置或者重复一些有意义的东西。

lines.en: scene utanaragain1
Maybe tonight, I’ll replay something I haven’t seen in quite some time — a silent, contemplative night with a younger girl that doesn’t end in sex.
lines.zh: 也许今晚，我要重播一段很久没看过的东西——和一个年纪更小的女孩一起度过的、安静而沉思的、不以性爱收场的夜晚。

lines.en: We have been here before.
lines.zh: 我们以前来过这儿。

lines.en: But that was before I knew that she knew something.
lines.zh: 但那是在我知道她知道了某些事之前。

lines.en: : Well, if it isn’t Uta Ushibori.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这不是 Uta Ushibori 吗。

lines.en: That’s okay, though.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: Because we both want to ignore it.
lines.zh: 因为我们两个都想装作不知道。

lines.en: : What...what are you doing out here? It’s kind of late, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你……你在这儿干什么？已经挺晚了吧？

lines.en: : I’m on my way back from your room.
lines.zh: : 我刚从你房间回来。

lines.en: : My room? But-
lines.zh: : 我的房间？可——

lines.en: scene utanaragain2
: Hey, wait a second! Are you actually on your way back from my room? Or are you just repeating our dialogue from the last time we met like this?!
lines.zh: : 喂，等一下！你是真的刚从我房间回来？还是只是在像上次见面那样重复我们的台词？！

lines.en: : I’m surprised you remember that.
lines.zh: : 真没想到你还记得那个。

lines.en: scene utanaragain3
: I’m surprised {i}you{/i} remember. Aren’t you supposed to have memory issues or something? Or is Uta-chan just so unforgettable that she’s exempt from them?
lines.zh: : 我才没想到{i}你{/i}还记得。你不是应该有记忆方面的问题吗？还是说 Uta 酱太令人难忘了，所以被豁免了？

lines.en: : You’ve always been my favorite, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟你一直是我最喜欢的。

lines.en: scene utanaragain4
: By design, of course. Uta-chan is the result of painstaking research into the entire concept of cuteness. Your love for her is simply a byproduct of my hard work.
lines.zh: : 当然是设计出来的。Uta 酱是对“可爱”这整个概念进行煞费苦心的研究后得出的成果。你对她的爱，不过是我辛勤工作的副产品。

lines.en: : Are you free again tonight?
lines.zh: : 你今晚又有空吗？

lines.en: scene utanaragain5
: Heh...
: It doesn’t really matter if I’m free or not. I don’t know how to say no to you.
lines.zh: : 我有没有空其实并不重要。我不知道该怎么对你说不。

lines.en: : Technically, you’ve said no to me probably a thousand times now. You definitely know how.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，你已经对我说过大概一千次不了。你肯定知道怎么说。

lines.en: : I’ve said no to sexy stuff because my chastity must be protected at all costs or humanity will collapse. I’d never turn down an invitation like this, though.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝的是色色的事，因为我的贞操必须不惜一切代价守住，否则人类就会崩塌。不过像这样的邀请，我是绝不会拒绝的。

lines.en: scene utanaragain3
: But I guess that doesn’t really matter since I’m free anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过反正我今晚有空，所以这些大概也不重要了。

lines.en: : So you were just giving me the runaround out of habit?
lines.zh: : 所以你刚才只是在习惯性地绕圈子？

lines.en: : Would you expect any less at this point?
lines.zh: : 到了这个地步，你还指望我少绕点吗？

lines.en: : Depends on which Uta I’m talking to. One of them is actually really nervous all the time.
lines.zh: : 那得看我在跟哪个 Uta 说话。其中一个其实一直都很紧张。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that one’s busy tonight. But Uta-chan can keep you company so long as you promise to keep your hands in the vehicle at all times.
lines.zh: : 我很确定那一位今晚很忙。不过只要你答应全程把手放在车里，Uta 酱可以陪你。

lines.en: : Are we just returning to our spot, then? Or did you want to try somewhere else tonight?
lines.zh: : 那我们是回我们的老地方，还是你今晚想换个地方试试？

lines.en: scene utanaragain6
: It’s cute that you’d call it “our spot.”
lines.zh: : 你把它叫做“我们的老地方”，还挺可爱的。

lines.en: : That’s what it is, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 本来就是嘛，不是吗？

lines.en: : Doesn’t change how cute it is.
lines.zh: : 这也不影响它有多可爱。

lines.en: : Is Uta-chan allowed to be so forward with her flirting? Or did you want to try and add a few more suggestive layers to those past couple sentences?
lines.zh: : Uta 酱调情可以这么直接吗？还是你想给刚才那几句话再多加几层暗示？

lines.en: scene utanaragain5
: It doesn’t matter how many layers there are when I’m just going to wind up shedding all of them for you no matter what happens.
lines.zh: : 加多少层都没关系，反正不管发生什么，我最后都会一层层为你剥掉。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on! Let’s head to our spot.
lines.zh: : 走吧！我们去我们的老地方。

lines.en: scene utanaragain7
So far, so good, I guess.
lines.zh: 到目前为止，还算顺利吧。

lines.en: Uta seems a little off. But I imagine it’s hard {i}not{/i} being a little off when you’re alone in the dark with a man who could lift you up and carry you away without any effort at all.
lines.zh: Uta 看起来有点不对劲。不过我想，当你和一个能毫不费力就把你举起来扛走的男人单独待在黑暗里，{i}不{/i}有点不对劲反而很难。

lines.en: I doubt tonight’s the night for that, though.
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑今晚不会是那一晚。

lines.en: And to be honest, I doubt I’ll even {i}have{/i} Uta-chan for much longer as its only a matter of time until we have to address the elephant in the gazebo.
lines.zh: 而且说实话，我怀疑我还能{i}拥有{/i} Uta 酱多久了——毕竟我们迟早得谈谈凉亭里那头大象。

lines.en: If Io knows, Uta knows.
lines.zh: 如果 Io 知道，Uta 就知道。

lines.en: And if Uta knows...
lines.zh: 而如果 Uta 知道……

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I have no idea what she’ll do.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道她会怎么做。

lines.en: And based on her rare silence, I’m not sure she does either.
lines.zh: 而从她罕见的沉默来看，我不确定她自己知道。

lines.en: : So...what’s new, Sensei? How are things now that life is getting back to normal for you?
lines.zh: : 那么……最近怎么样，Sensei？生活终于回到正轨了，感觉如何？

lines.en: : Horrible. But I have a daughter now, so that’s new.
lines.zh: : 糟透了。不过我现在有个女儿了，所以这算是新鲜事。

lines.en: scene utanaragain8
: You {i}what?!{/i} With {i}who?!{/i} And how do you just casually drop a bomb like that without even changing expressions?!
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么{/i}？！跟{i}谁{/i}？！你怎么能面不改色地随口就丢下这么一颗炸弹？！

lines.en: : Relax. I’m just talking about Ami.
lines.zh: : 放松。我说的就是 Ami。

lines.en: : You had a baby with Ami?! Is {i}that{/i} why she was acting so hormonal at the maid cafe the other day?!
lines.zh: : 你跟 Ami 生了个孩子？！{i}那{/i}就是她前几天在女仆咖啡厅表现得那么荷尔蒙失调的原因吗？！

lines.en: : No, Ami {i}is{/i} the daughter I’m referring to. We decided it’s best if she stops calling me her uncle and- wait, what do you mean “hormonal?”
lines.zh: : 不是，Ami{i}就是{/i}我说的那个女儿。我们觉得她最好别再叫我叔叔了，然后——等等，你说“荷尔蒙失调”是什么意思？

lines.en: scene utanaragain9
: Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Uta...if Ami is acting strange again, I need to know. I had a feeling she wasn’t ready to go back to work yet, but she’s been adamant about getting out of the house and-
lines.zh: : Uta……如果 Ami 又有什么奇怪的举动，我需要知道。我本来就觉得她还没准备好回去工作，可她一直坚持要走出家门，然后——

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t know what you’re thinking might have happened, but I can promise you it was something completely different.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我不知道你在想可能发生了什么，但我可以向你保证，完全是另一回事。

lines.en: : Different...how?
lines.zh: : 另一回事……怎么说？

lines.en: scene utanaragain10
: Hey! Here’s a new topic! Have you seen Io lately?
lines.zh: : 嘿！换个新话题！你最近见过 Io 吗？

lines.en: : ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ……Sensei？

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 你为什么问这个？

lines.en: scene utanaragain11
: Just...cause she’s been acting a little weird, that’s all. She’s staying over at the bathhouse more often than normal, so I wasn’t sure if something happened with {i}you{/i} or...
lines.zh: : 只是……因为她最近有点怪，就这样。她待在澡堂过夜的次数比平时多，所以我不确定是不是{i}你{/i}这边出了什么事，或者……

lines.en: : If maybe she's still upset about something {i}else{/i} that happened or...
lines.zh: : 或者她还因为{i}别的{/i}发生过的事在闹情绪，或者……

lines.en: : I haven’t seen her, no.
lines.zh: : 我没见过她，没有。

lines.en: scene utanaragain12
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve been too busy trying to get my life back in order.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我一直在忙着重整自己的生活。

lines.en: scene utanaragain13
: Darn it. It’s probably just her stupid brain being a stupid brain again, then.
lines.zh: : 该死。那大概只是她那颗蠢脑子又在犯蠢了。

lines.en: : I keep trying to check on her, but she’s being really stubborn about dealing with stuff on her own this time.
lines.zh: : 我一直想去看她，可她这次特别固执，非要说自己一个人扛。

lines.en: : I just hope she doesn’t hurt herself. But if you don’t know anything, I guess I shouldn’t get you involved.
lines.zh: : 我只希望她别伤到自己。不过既然你什么都不知道，那我想我也不该把你卷进来。

lines.en: Has Io really not said anything to Uta about what happened at the bathhouse the other night?
lines.zh: Io 真的没跟 Uta 说过那天晚上在澡堂发生的事吗？

lines.en: That’s both a huge relief and...also kind of worrying. I didn’t think she kept secrets from Uta like that.
lines.zh: 这既是极大的松了口气……也有点让人担心。我没想到她会对 Uta 瞒这种事。

lines.en: Is it possible she...doesn’t know about the picture, then?
lines.zh: 那么，有没有可能她……根本不知道那张照片的事？

lines.en: Am I in the clear?
lines.zh: 我脱身了吗？

lines.en: scene utanaragain14
: Anything else you want to tell me about, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，你还有别的事想跟我说吗？

lines.en: Ah...
Of course that’d be too simple.
lines.zh: 果然不会那么简单。

lines.en: : Can we maybe just stand here in silence for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能就这样再安静地站一会儿？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : But if you have something you want to talk to me about, now’s the time to do it.
lines.zh: : 但如果你有什么想跟我说的，现在就是时候。

lines.en: : There’s no one else around. I’m the only one who will hear whatever it is you have to say.
lines.zh: : 周围没有别人。不管你想说什么，只有我会听到。

lines.en: : And I might talk a lot...but I’m a good listener, Sensei. I promise to hear you out no matter what it is.
lines.zh: : 还有，虽然我很爱说话……但我是个好听众，Sensei。不管是什么，我保证都会听完。

lines.en: scene utanaragain15
And just like that, the tone shifts.
lines.zh: 就这样，气氛变了。

lines.en: Just like that, the mirage vanishes — and in its place sits the sad truth of a sad man, blaming sadness for all of the sad things he does.
lines.zh: 就这样，海市蜃楼消失了——取而代之的，是一个可悲男人的可悲真相，他把自己的一切可悲行径都归咎于悲伤。

lines.en: It’s him and some girl — barely up to his shoulders in height. One who’s made some questionable decisions in the past, but doesn’t really {i}deserve{/i} any of the bad things that have happened to her.
lines.zh: 是他，和某个女孩——身高还不到他的肩膀。她过去做过一些有问题的决定，但并不真的{i}该承受{/i}发生在她身上的那些坏事。

lines.en: Yet here she is, putting herself in harm’s way once more. Like she {i}wants{/i} bad things to happen to her.
lines.zh: 可她现在又把自己送进了险境。就好像她{i}盼着{/i}坏事发生在自己身上。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I’d say if I didn’t know her as well as I do now.
lines.zh: 至少，如果我没有现在这样了解她，我会这么说。

lines.en: Now, I know that it’s {i}less{/i} about a love for danger, and {i}more{/i} about being so desperate for something {i}good{/i} to happen that she’ll put herself at risk over and over and over again.
lines.zh: 而现在我知道，这{i}与其说{/i}是热爱危险，{i}不如说{/i}是她太渴望发生一点{i}好{/i}事，以至于她会一次又一次地把自己置于险地。

lines.en: It’s kind of sickening, really — that level of carelessness. Of {i}stupidity.{/i} How she runs the ramps of recklessness in a way that sends that tiny body of hers speeding toward inevitable destruction.
lines.zh: 说真的，这挺让人作呕的——那种满不在乎。那种{i}愚蠢{/i}。她冲下一次又一次鲁莽的坡道，让那具小小的身体朝着不可避免的毁灭疾驰。

lines.en: But at the end, there is no blanket — nor a pit of foam to break her fall.
lines.zh: 可到了尽头，既没有毯子，也没有一坑泡沫来接住她。

lines.en: It’s just me — with arms stretched out wide, staring deep into her soul as if to say “{i}I{/i} will be that good thing.” But I am the devil.
lines.zh: 只有{i}我{/i}——双臂大张，深深望进她的灵魂，仿佛在说“我会成为那件好事”。可我是魔鬼。

lines.en: I am the snake crawling up her leg.
lines.zh: 我是顺着她的腿爬上去的蛇。

lines.en: The shadow of a past that she wishes to escape, yet can’t bring herself to stop looking back at.
lines.zh: 是她想要逃离、却又忍不住一再回望的过去的阴影。

lines.en: It may not have started with me...and it may not {i}end{/i} with me either.
lines.zh: 也许一切不是从我开始的……也许也不会在我这里{i}结束{/i}。

lines.en: But I will be a pit stop on her long road to hell if this side of her never changes.
lines.zh: 但如果她这一面永远不变，我会成为她通往地狱的长路上的一个落脚点。

lines.en: : Why don’t you ask me a question?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不问我一个问题？

lines.en: scene utanaragain12
: A question?...
lines.zh: : 一个问题？……

lines.en: : Yeah. As many as you want, actually.
lines.zh: : 对。其实问多少个都行。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : It’ll be easier to tell you if I don’t have to take the initiative.
lines.zh: : 如果不用由我来起头，我会比较容易说出口。

lines.en: : So you want to, like...turn it into a game?
lines.zh: : 所以你是想……把它变成某种游戏？

lines.en: : Cowardly, I know.
lines.zh: : 很懦弱，我知道。

lines.en: scene utanaragain7
: No, I get it...
lines.zh: : 不，我懂……

lines.en: : Talking about stuff can be hard. I see that all the time in all sorts of people. I’m not really an exception either. Surprising, I know — seeing as I can never keep my mouth shut and all.
lines.zh: : 把事情说出来是很难的。我在各种各样的人身上都见过。我自己也不例外。很意外吧——毕竟我从来都管不住自己的嘴。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you have parts of you that you excel at keeping hidden. Of course you wouldn’t blab about those.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但你身上有些部分你特别擅长藏起来。那些你当然不会到处乱说。

lines.en: : You have parts just like that too, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你身上也有那样的部分，Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
: So I guess it’s time to start connecting some dots...
lines.zh: : 那么，我想是时候开始把一些点连起来了……

lines.en: : And see the ways in which we line up...
lines.zh: : 看看我们在哪些方面重合……

lines.en: scene utanaragain16
: Question one — how do you feel about me?
lines.zh: : 问题一——你觉得我怎么样？

lines.en: : Which one?
lines.zh: : 哪个我？

lines.en: : Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱。

lines.en: : Is that still the one I’m talking to? Because I was under the impression you body-swapped again.
lines.zh: : 我现在说话的对象还是她吗？因为我印象里你又换了个人格。

lines.en: : Then why not tell me how you feel about both? Just starting with Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 那你何不说说你对两个都是什么感觉？先从 Uta 酱开始就行。

lines.en: : I think Uta-chan is the perfect girl. Just like you want her to be.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Uta 酱是完美的女孩。正是你希望她成为的样子。

lines.en: : I think she’s funny and cute. And way too good at her job. And she drives me insane with her endless cycle of flirting that leads to nothing. Not to mention I’ve spent probably half a million yen on her by now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她有趣又可爱。而且工作能力强得过头。还有，她那套永远不会有结果的调情循环快把我逼疯了。更别提我到现在大概已经在她身上花了五十万日元了。

lines.en: : And how do you feel about Uta Ushibori?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得 Uta Ushibori 怎么样？

lines.en: : I think she’s a fucking mess.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她一团他妈的乱。

lines.en: : I think the complex she’s created in which she can’t function unless there’s a failsafe version of her tucked into her back pocket is juvenile. I think she’s perverted and lacks common sense.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她造出来的那套东西——非得把一个备用版本的自己揣在后口袋里才能正常运转——很幼稚。我觉得她变态，而且缺乏常识。

lines.en: : I think the way she cares for everyone is actually {i}careless{/i} since it opens her up to the possibility of being hurt by so many different people.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她关心所有人的方式其实是{i}不计后果{/i}的，因为那让她向那么多不同的人敞开了被伤害的可能。

lines.en: : I despise that there are so many other men just like me who sit in front of dimly lit computer screens, jerking off to her pictures and I hate that she’s figured out a way to monetize those fantasies at her work.
lines.zh: : 我厌恶这世上有那么多和我一样的男人，坐在昏暗的电脑屏幕前对着她的照片打飞机；我也恨她居然想出了办法，在工作里把那些幻想变现。

lines.en: : I hate so many things about her. It’s infuriating. But it’s like watching a train-wreck...and I can’t look away.
lines.zh: : 我恨她身上这么多东西。简直让人火大。可这就像看一场火车相撞……我移不开眼。

lines.en: : I like her so, {i}so{/i} much more...
lines.zh: : 我好喜欢她，{i}好{/i}喜欢……

lines.en: scene utanaragain17
: That was a much better answer than the one Ami gave me.
lines.zh: : 这个答案比 Ami 给我的那个好多了。

lines.en: : What’d {i}she{/i} say?
lines.zh: : {i}她{/i}说什么了？

lines.en: : That she used to touch herself in your bed.
lines.zh: : 说她以前在你的床上自慰。

lines.en: : Yeah...that sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……听着挺像她会说的。

lines.en: scene utanaragain18
: I probably should have acted a little more surprised than I did, but...honestly, I kind of had a feeling.
lines.zh: : 我应该表现得比刚才更惊讶一点的，不过……说实话，我大概早就有点感觉了。

lines.en: : She doesn’t really do a good job of hiding it, I’ll be the first to admit that.
lines.zh: : 她藏得确实不好，这点我第一个承认。

lines.en: : But why were you two talking about that in the first place?
lines.zh: : 可你们俩一开始为什么会聊到那个？

lines.en: : So I would know what to say when the time came to talk to {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这样我才知道，到时候该对{i}你{/i}说什么。

lines.en: scene utanaragain19
: Question two...
lines.zh: : 问题二……

lines.en: : How did you get them?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么弄到它们的？

lines.en: : It’s not {i}them.{/i} It’s just one.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}它们{/i}。只有一张。

lines.en: scene utanaragain20
: Then...how did you get {i}it?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那……你是怎么弄到{i}它{/i}的？

lines.en: : Like...did you go out of your way to {i}look{/i} for my pictures when I told you about them? Because I get them taken down from websites and stuff pretty regularly, but...
lines.zh: : 比如……是我跟你提过之后，你特意去{i}搜{/i}我的照片了吗？因为我会定期把网站上的那些撤下来，可是……

lines.en: : There are probably some I...don’t know about...and stuff...
lines.zh: : 大概还有一些我自己……不知道的……之类的……

lines.en: : I didn’t look for anything. Some...random number sent it to me out of nowhere one day.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没搜。某天有个……陌生号码莫名其妙发给了我。

lines.en: scene utanaragain21
: That’s what I was afraid of.
lines.zh: : 这正是我最怕的。

lines.en: : I mean...isn’t that better than me going out of my way to look for them, though?
lines.zh: : 我是说……可这总比我特意去搜要好吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. Because this means it could happen to {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然不好。因为这意味着{i}任何人{/i}都可能碰上这种事。

lines.en: scene utanaragain22
: I really am {i}never{/i} safe, huh?
lines.zh: : 我真的{i}永远{/i}都不安全，是吗？

lines.en: : You were never supposed to know, Uta. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 你本来就不该知道的，Uta。对不起。

lines.en: scene utanaragain23
: You were really just going to secretly jerk off to it for the rest of forever? What do you {i}mean{/i} I was never supposed to know?
lines.zh: : 你就打算这么偷偷对着它打一辈子飞机？{i}什么叫{/i}我本来就不该知道？

lines.en: : I mean that {i}you{/i} should know better than anyone how fucked up it is for me to {i}have{/i} something like that in the first-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，{i}你{/i}比谁都清楚，我{i}持有{/i}那种东西本身就是多么变态——

lines.en: scene utanaragain24
: Sensei, {i}I{/i} took those pictures! I am the {i}last{/i} person who should be telling you about how wrong it is. I {i}created{/i} this problem. You’re just a dumb boy with really creepy taste.
lines.zh: : Sensei，{i}我才是{/i}拍那些照片的人！我是{i}最没资格{/i}来告诉你这有多不对的人。是我{i}制造{/i}了这个问题。你只是个品味很 creepy 的蠢小子。

lines.en: : But you were just...stupid and needy back then. You had no idea what you were doing. You said it yourself.
lines.zh: : 可你那时候只是……又蠢又黏人。你根本不知道自己在干什么。你自己说的。

lines.en: scene utanaragain25
: I have no idea what I’m doing {i}today{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 我{i}今天{/i}也不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : All logic says I should be totally skeeved out right now.
lines.zh: : 按理说，我现在应该恶心得要命才对。

lines.en: : I should report you to the police or...tell the rest of the girls about the person you {i}really{/i} are. Which, granted, isn’t {i}that{/i} much different from who we already {i}know{/i} you are.
lines.zh: : 我应该报警，或者……告诉其他女孩你{i}真正{/i}是个什么样的人。虽然话说回来，那跟我们已经{i}知道{/i}的你也没{i}那么{/i}大差别。

lines.en: : And, you know...maybe I kind of am a little grossed out. But I’m also {i}not.{/i} I’m also {i}happy.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且，你知道的……也许我确实有那么一点反感。但我也{i}不反感{/i}。我也很{i}开心{/i}。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t be happy, Uta...
lines.zh: : 你不该开心的，Uta……

lines.en: scene utanaragain26

: You think I don’t know that?! Do you think I {i}want{/i} to be such a degenerate?! Because my life would be so much friggin’ easier if I wasn’t, Sensei! This wouldn’t have ever been a problem in the first place!
lines.zh: : 你以为我不知道吗？！你以为我{i}想{/i}当这种堕落的人吗？！如果我不是，我的人生会他妈轻松太多了，Sensei！这件事从一开始就根本不会成为问题！

lines.en: : I have no idea what you want me to say to you right now.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道此刻你到底想让我说什么。

lines.en: : I was ready for you to cut things off for good. I thought this was going to be the last time we ever came out here.
lines.zh: : 我已经做好了你要彻底断绝关系的准备。我以为这会是我们最后一次来这儿。

lines.en: scene utanaragain27
: You could tell me to my face you’re never coming back and I would still wait for you here.
lines.zh: : 你可以当面告诉我你再也不来了，我照样会在这儿等你。

lines.en: : That’s how I really feel about you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这就是我对你的真实感觉，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yes, it’s messed up that you never told me about that picture. But it’s also kind of flattering in a...really creepy...super illegal way...
lines.zh: : 是的，你从没告诉我那张照片的事，这很糟糕。但换个角度说，也有点让人受用——以一种……很变态……超级违法的方式……

lines.en: scene utanaragain28
: Just please don’t tell Io I said that. I think she’s kind of expecting me to start hating you or something and I...don’t really know how to tell her I’m sort of...okay with it.
lines.zh: : 只是求你别把我这话告诉 Io。我觉得她大概正等着我开始恨你之类的，而我……真不知道该怎么开口告诉她，我其实有点……能接受。

lines.en: : Just for you, though...
lines.zh: : 只对你一个人能接受……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t do this for anybody else...
lines.zh: : 换作别人我不会这样……

lines.en: : Question three...
lines.zh: : 问题三……

lines.en: : We’re still playing?
lines.zh: : 还在玩？

lines.en: scene utanaragain29
: Do you need help?
lines.zh: : 你需要帮助吗？

lines.en: : ...What?
: Because I think there’s like...
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得有那种……

lines.en: scene utanaragain30
: So there are, like...people you can talk to, I think...
lines.zh: : 就是说，有那种……可以聊的人，我觉得……

lines.en: : Me and Io met in a similar kinda way, but...like...
lines.zh: : 我和 Io 相遇的方式也差不多，不过……就是……

lines.en: : If there are parts of you that...you want to change...you know, like...if you don’t want to be interested in the...same sort of...{i}stuff{/i} anymore...
lines.zh: : 如果你身上有些部分……是你想改变的……你知道的，比如……如果你不想再对……同一类……{i}东西{/i}感兴趣了……

lines.en: : Like...I’m not really sure if it’s therapy, or...I don’t know what to call it...
lines.zh: : 就是……我不太确定那算不算心理治疗，或者……我不知道该怎么称呼它……

lines.en: : But if you don’t want to be who you already are anymore...I could try and...help you find a way...
lines.zh: : 但如果你不想再做现在的自己了……我可以试着……帮你找条路……

lines.en: scene utanaragain31
: None of that made sense, did it?
lines.zh: : 刚才那些话说得一点都不连贯，对吧？
: 为什么？……

lines.en: scene utanaragain32
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Why does everyone keep trying to help me?...
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都一直想帮我？……

lines.en: scene utanaragain33
: I don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: : I don’t understand!
lines.zh: : 我不明白！

lines.en: : I’m doing everything wrong and you {i}still{/i} want to help me!
lines.zh: : 我把一切都搞砸了，而你{i}还是{/i}想帮我！

lines.en: scene utanaragain34
: When will one of you hold me accountable?! Where will any of you draw the line?! Is there no end to what I can do?! Can I seriously do anything I want?! {i}Anything?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你们什么时候才有一个人肯让我负起责任？！你们到底在哪儿划线？！我做什么都可以没有尽头吗？！我真的可以做任何我想做的事吗？！{i}任何事{/i}？！

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei! Shh!
lines.zh: : Sensei！嘘！

lines.en: scene utanaragain35
The girl from Nara wraps her arms around me.
lines.zh: 来自 Nara 的女孩张开双臂抱住了我。

lines.en: She must think I have deer parts.
lines.zh: 她大概是以为我身上长着鹿的零件。

lines.en: : I can’t speak for anyone else, but I’m stupid...
lines.zh: : 别人怎么样我说不好，可我很蠢……

lines.en: : Ngh...
: You said it yourself, didn’t you?...
lines.zh: : 你自己说过的，不是吗？……

lines.en: : I’m a fucking mess...I can’t function unless there’s a failsafe version of me tucked into my back pocket...
lines.zh: : 我一团他妈的乱……非得把一个备用版本的自己揣在后口袋里才能正常运转……

lines.en: : I’m a filthy pervert...who lacks common sense...
lines.zh: : 我是个下流的变态……而且还缺乏常识……

lines.en: : There are thousands of men in front of dimly lit computer screens, jerking off to pictures of me...
lines.zh: : 有成千上万的男人坐在昏暗的电脑屏幕前，对着我的照片打飞机……

lines.en: : But I’m happy that you’re one of them...and I won’t call you a bad person because {i}I{/i} don’t have the right to...
lines.zh: : 可{i}我{/i}很高兴你是他们中的一个……我也不会说你是坏人，因为我没有那个资格……

lines.en: : Let’s be stupid together, okay?...
lines.zh: : 我们一起犯蠢吧，好吗？……

lines.en: : You’re making a mistake...
lines.zh: : 你在犯错……

lines.en: scene utanaragain36
: I’ve always been good at that...
lines.zh: : 我一直都很擅长犯错……

lines.en: : But there are other things I can be good at, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 但还有别的事是我可以擅长的，Sensei……

lines.en: : And I want you to find out what those things are with me...
lines.zh: : 而我想让你和我一起，去找出那些事是什么……

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter if it’s here or Nara...
lines.zh: : 是在这儿还是在 Nara 都无所谓……

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter if it’s in this life or another...
lines.zh: : 是在这一世还是另一世也无所谓……

lines.en: scene black
: I want a future with you...
lines.zh: : 我想要一个和你一起的未来……

lines.en: : I don’t care what shape or size...
lines.zh: : 我不在乎它是什么形状、什么尺寸……

lines.en: : I don’t care if you think you deserve it or not...
lines.zh: : 我不在乎你觉得自己配不配得上……

lines.en: : It’s what I want...
lines.zh: : 这就是我想要的……

lines.en: : Please...
lines.zh: : 求你了……

lines.en: : Will you let me take a bite out of your heart?...
lines.zh: : 能让我在你的心上咬一口吗？……

$ utaspring2 = True
{i}Uta’s affection has increased by 25!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升了 25!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You decide to keep the picture.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你决定留下那张照片。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’ll look at it together one day.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}总有一天，你们会一起看它。{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
: It’s happening again...
lines.zh: : 又来了……

lines.en: scene black
{i}Blackest night, envelop me-\nProtect me from my dreams{/i}
lines.zh:
{i}至暗之夜，将我笼罩——
护我远离我的梦境{/i}

lines.en: {i}For in them, I hear nothing\nNot the cherub, nor its screams{i}
lines.zh:
{i}因为在梦中，我什么也听不见
听不见基路伯，也听不见它的尖叫{/i}
